items.title: Jensen Huang resigns

items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly resigns amid affair reports and export scrutiny
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly steps down amid affair reports and scrutiny over export-ban compliance, sparking massive community debate.

items.title: Anthropic IPO

items.title_en: Anthropic Files for IPO at a Valuation Near $1 Trillion
items.summary: Anthropic files for IPO with a valuation near $1 trillion, prompting community analysis of financials, market dynamics, and AI competition.

items.title: Moderna 与默沙东宣布疫苗三期成功，黑色素瘤术后复发风险显著下降  Moderna 与默沙东于 2026 年 8 月 19 日宣布，个性化 mRNA 癌症
items.title_zh: Moderna 与默沙东个性化 mRNA 癌症疫苗三期试验达主要终点
items.title_en: Moderna and Merck's personalized mRNA cancer vaccine hits Phase 3 endpoints in melanoma
items.summary: Moderna and Merck announced that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine combined with Keytruda met primary endpoints in a Phase 3 melanoma trial, significantly reducing recurrence and distant metastasis risk.

items.title: Rust 1.100
items.title_zh: Rust 1.100 正式稳定 never 类型、自定义分配器与 Cargo 依赖冷却机制
items.title_en: Rust 1.100 stabilizes never type, custom allocators, and Cargo dependency cooldowns
items.summary: Rust 1.100 ships major long-term feature stabilizations including the never type, custom allocators, Cargo dependency cooldowns, and unused dependency reporting.

items.title_en: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator for Agentic Workflows
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator, prompting discussion about multi-model routing, caching, naming, and practical model-selection workflows.

items.title: Show HN: My $300 embroidery machine needed a subscription, so I built my own app
items.title_zh: Show HN：开发者自建开源应用，绕开刺绣机的订阅限制
items.title_en: Show HN: Developer builds open-source app to bypass embroidery machine subscription
items.summary: A developer built an open-source app to bypass his embroidery machine's subscription requirement, sparking a rich HN discussion on reverse engineering, right-to-repair, and AI-assisted de-bricking of legacy hardware.

items.title: Nvidia and the World Without Jensen

items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Asks Whether Nvidia Survives a World Without Jensen
items.summary: SemiAnalysis examines Nvidia's future amid export controls and US-China supply chain dependencies, exploring RASA, open source, and broader strategic implications.

items.title: UMAP 0.6: new initialization, new optimizers and faster performance [P]
items.title_zh: UMAP 0.6 引入递归初始化、新优化器与更快的最近邻搜索
items.title_en: UMAP 0.6 adds recursive initialization, new optimizers, faster nearest-neighbor search
items.summary: UMAP 0.6 introduces faster nearest-neighbor search, a new initialization method, and improved optimizers, enabling major speedups and better quality on million-scale datasets.

items.title: Does Meta's brain-response model (TRIBE v2) actually recover retinotopy/tonotopy/motion maps? [D]
items.title_zh: 独立审计发现 Meta 的 TRIBE v2 缺乏视网膜拓扑与音频拓扑映射
items.title_en: Independent audit: Meta's TRIBE v2 lacks retinotopic and tonotopic maps
items.summary: An independent analysis finds Meta's TRIBE v2 does not recover retinotopic or tonotopic maps, shows strong motion selectivity in MT+, and exposes an eccentricity confound in its position-related predictions.

items.title: 美国拟推全球 AI 芯片出口许可制度，强化 Nvidia 等巨头出货管控  美国商务部昨日拟定新规，要求美国企业向境外任何地区出口 AI 芯片均须获得政府许可，
items.title_zh: 美国拟推全球AI芯片出口许可制度，波及Nvidia等巨头
items.title_en: US Drafts Global AI Chip Export License Requirement for Nvidia and Peers
items.summary: The US Commerce Department has drafted a new rule requiring government licenses for all overseas AI chip exports and related US AI infrastructure investment, escalating global semiconductor export controls.
